new_destinations.name: Yangzhou
new_destinations.coordinates_source: osm:attraction 文昌阁 (Wenchang Pavilion), the old-city roundabout centre
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage has a Yangzhou page with See/Do listings (counted source on 17 Yangzhou/Gaoyou candidates); Slender West Lake is its headline.
new_destinations.reason: Grand Canal garden city: 13 kept spots (4 gardens/lake, 2 museums, temples, old streets) within 6 km of the centre; fully clears the four-spot bar and name test.

new_destinations.name: Taizhou
new_destinations.coordinates_source: candidates.json osm:attraction 望海楼 (Wanghailou); city-centre point to be re-resolved from OSM place=city
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage page "Taizhou (Jiangsu)" and China Daily Jiangsu Taizhou subsite list these attractions (counted sources for Wanghai Tower, Guangxiao Temple, Mei Lanfang Memorial Hall).
new_destinations.reason: Regional hub with 7 kept spots across its urban districts (Hailing, Gaogang, Jiangyan); no single headline so rank 5. Span 70 km holds Qintong (~28 km) with room.

spots.name: Slender West Lake
spots.reason: Inside Yangzhou urban area (within ~6 km of Wenchang Pavilion, the old-city centre), well within the 30 km span; visitors base in Yangzhou for it.
spots.bio: Scenic lake park northwest of the old city with pavilions, the Five-Pavilion Bridge and gardens around the water.

spots.name: Geyuan Garden
spots.reason: Inside Yangzhou urban area (within ~6 km of Wenchang Pavilion, the old-city centre), well within the 30 km span; visitors base in Yangzhou for it.
spots.bio: Classical garden famed for its bamboo and rockeries that represent the four seasons.

spots.name: He Garden
spots.reason: Inside Yangzhou urban area (within ~6 km of Wenchang Pavilion, the old-city centre), well within the 30 km span; visitors base in Yangzhou for it.
spots.bio: Classical scholar garden with tea houses, open grottoes and pleasant views, one of Jiangsu's best gardens.

spots.name: Dongguan Street
spots.coordinates_source: osm:attraction 东关古渡 (on Dongguan Street)
spots.reason: Inside Yangzhou urban area (within ~6 km of Wenchang Pavilion, the old-city centre), well within the 30 km span; visitors base in Yangzhou for it.
spots.bio: Old street and historic lanes east of the centre, with the Wudangxing Taoist palace and shops.

spots.name: Daming Temple
spots.reason: Inside Yangzhou urban area (within ~6 km of Wenchang Pavilion, the old-city centre), well within the 30 km span; visitors base in Yangzhou for it.
spots.bio: Buddhist temple on the Slender West Lake grounds, rebuilt after the Taiping Rebellion, with a spring and a tea house.

spots.name: Lu Family Salt Merchant Residence
spots.reason: Inside Yangzhou urban area (within ~6 km of Wenchang Pavilion, the old-city centre), well within the 30 km span; visitors base in Yangzhou for it.
spots.bio: Lavishly furnished 100-room mansion of a Qing-era salt merchant, open to visitors.

spots.name: Yangzhou Museum
spots.reason: Inside Yangzhou urban area (within ~6 km of Wenchang Pavilion, the old-city centre), well within the 30 km span; visitors base in Yangzhou for it.
spots.bio: City museum in the "Double Museum" building with a salvaged Grand Canal boat and a Tang dragon boat on display.

spots.name: China Grand Canal Museum
spots.reason: Inside Yangzhou urban area (within ~6 km of Wenchang Pavilion, the old-city centre), well within the 30 km span; visitors base in Yangzhou for it.
spots.bio: Museum on the Grand Canal dedicated to the canal's history and boats, free to enter.

spots.name: Xiaoqinhuai Canal
spots.reason: Inside Yangzhou urban area (within ~6 km of Wenchang Pavilion, the old-city centre), well within the 30 km span; visitors base in Yangzhou for it.
spots.bio: Canal walk that crosses the historic centre, with narrow lanes of the surviving old-city blocks nearby.

spots.name: Wenchang Pavilion
spots.reason: Inside Yangzhou urban area (within ~6 km of Wenchang Pavilion, the old-city centre), well within the 30 km span; visitors base in Yangzhou for it.
spots.bio: Three-storey Ming pavilion at a roundabout marking the symbolic centre of Yangzhou, one of its few surviving old buildings.

spots.name: Tianning Temple
spots.reason: Inside Yangzhou urban area (within ~6 km of Wenchang Pavilion, the old-city centre), well within the 30 km span; visitors base in Yangzhou for it.
spots.bio: Large Buddhist temple with several halls and courtyards, a copy of the Siku Quanshu and a Buddhist culture exhibit.

spots.name: Shi Kefa Memorial
spots.reason: Inside Yangzhou urban area (within ~6 km of Wenchang Pavilion, the old-city centre), well within the 30 km span; visitors base in Yangzhou for it.
spots.bio: Memorial hall and temple to the Ming general who refused to surrender Yangzhou to the Qing in 1645.

spots.name: Tomb of Puhaddin
spots.reason: Inside Yangzhou urban area (within ~6 km of Wenchang Pavilion, the old-city centre), well within the 30 km span; visitors base in Yangzhou for it.
spots.bio: Ming-era Islamic tomb complex and park of a 13th-century missionary, with a small exhibit on the Hui community.

spots.name: Longshan Mountain Scenic Resort
spots.reason: Standalone: Yizheng is a separate county-level city outside the Yangzhou urban area; 4 or fewer Yizheng places kept, no destination. Reached from Yizheng, not part of Yangzhou bounds. Coordinates unresolved, so exact distance to Yangzhou (about 25-30 km) to be confirmed at pin resolution.
spots.bio: Hill-top scenic resort and forest park in Qingshan town, the main draw of Yizheng city.

spots.name: Yucheng Postal Stop
spots.coordinates_source: osm:historic 运河·盂城驿历史文化街区
spots.reason: Standalone: Gaoyou, ~42 km north of Yangzhou centre and a separate county-level city; outside Yangzhou bounds. Only 3 Gaoyou places kept (no destination).
spots.bio: Early-Ming courier relay station on the Grand Canal, the most complete surviving postal stop of its kind.

spots.name: Zhenguo Temple
spots.reason: Standalone: Gaoyou, ~42 km from Yangzhou, outside its bounds; 3 Gaoyou places only. Slug suffixed to stay unique.
spots.bio: Buddhist temple on a small island in the Grand Canal with a pagoda that dates to the Tang era.

spots.name: Gaoyou Old Town
spots.reason: Standalone: the town itself is a draw (markets, old lanes); Gaoyou is outside Yangzhou bounds. Pin unresolved: the Wikivoyage page gives the town centre.
spots.bio: Old town of Gaoyou with antique shops, morning food markets and street life.

spots.name: Qianduo Scenic Area
spots.reason: Standalone: Xinghua, ~60 km from Taizhou centre, outside its bounds and span; nothing else kept nearby. Seasonal flowers but a permanent scenic area.
spots.bio: Canola flower fields across canal islets north of Xinghua, a spring draw from late March to April.

spots.name: Wanghai Tower
spots.reason: Taizhou city proper (Hailing, Gaogang, Jiangyan districts); ~0 km from centre point (it is the centre point); inside the 70 km span.
spots.bio: Newly built tower in the Fengcheng River scenic area of Taizhou city, with views over the riverside.

spots.name: Guangxiao Temple
spots.reason: Taizhou city proper (Hailing, Gaogang, Jiangyan districts); in the urban area; inside the 70 km span.
spots.bio: Buddhist temple in Taizhou city, named in the Taizhou government list of historic sites.

spots.name: Mei Lanfang Memorial Hall
spots.reason: Taizhou city proper (Hailing, Gaogang, Jiangyan districts); in the urban area; inside the 70 km span.
spots.bio: Park and memorial museum to the Peking Opera master Mei Lanfang, born in Taizhou.

spots.name: PLA Navy Establishment Memorial Hall
spots.coordinates_source: osm:museum 中国人民解放军海军诞生地纪念馆
spots.reason: Taizhou city proper (Hailing, Gaogang, Jiangyan districts); ~6 km east; inside the 70 km span.
spots.bio: Memorial museum at the birthplace of the People's Navy, where the navy was founded in Taizhou.

spots.name: Qinhu Lake National Wetland Park
spots.coordinates_source: osm:attraction 溱湖国家湿地公园野生动植物保护中心 (park visitor centre)
spots.reason: Taizhou city proper (Hailing, Gaogang, Jiangyan districts); ~25 km NE, Jiangyan district; inside the 70 km span.
spots.bio: National wetland park in Jiangyan with reeds, dawn redwoods, lotus and poplars beside the lake.

spots.name: Qintong Ancient Town
spots.coordinates_source: osm:attraction 溱潼古镇旅游景区
spots.reason: Taizhou city proper (Hailing, Gaogang, Jiangyan districts); ~28 km NE, Jiangyan district; inside the 70 km span.
spots.bio: Ancient town in Jiangyan district, a 4A-rated attraction beside Qinhu Lake.

spots.name: Guluotang Cultural Block
spots.coordinates_source: osm:viewpoint 姜堰古罗塘文化景区
spots.reason: Taizhou city proper (Hailing, Gaogang, Jiangyan districts); ~22 km E, Jiangyan district; inside the 70 km span.
spots.bio: Historic cultural block in the north of Jiangyan district, rated 4A.

neighbour_notes: Standalone spots within ~40 km of a proposed centre: Longshan (Yizheng, ~25-30 km SW of Yangzhou, outside Yangzhou bounds: separate county-level city); Gaoyou trio (~42 km N of Yangzhou, outside bounds). Qianduo is 60 km from Taizhou. Yangzhou to Taizhou centres are 48 km apart, no overlap. Yangzhou-Zhenjiang sibling (~23 km) is checked by the prescreen against existing data only; Zhenjiang is proposed by a sibling run and should be re-checked at merge time.
